Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished square baby milestone artwork, a standalone printable illustration on a pure white background, not a photograph of clothing and not a mockup. Inspired by the attached reference's cute hand-painted watercolor mermaid-and-large-numeral design. Soft storybook watercolor texture, sweet smiling chibi mermaid with flowing hair, rosy cheeks, delicate sea accents. One large chunky rounded numeral is the main shape; mermaid nestles beside/overlaps its lower right edge without hiding the number or text. The exact word "Month" must appear INSIDE the colored stroke of the numeral, vertically rotated reading bottom to top, in clear elegant cream lettering. Only two text elements: the requested numeral and "Month" (singular exactly). No person name, no other text, no logo, no watermark. Mermaid wears a modest opaque short-sleeved fitted bodice that covers her chest AND her entire stomach all the way to the tail; one continuous covered outfit, absolutely no bare belly or navel. Face and arms may be visible. Beautiful scaled fishtail. Centered complete design with generous white margin, crisp print-quality edges, matching visual scale across the series.
Text numeral (verbatim): "1". Individual design: Large deep teal numeral 1; golden blonde wavy hair with aqua bow; turquoise and ocean-blue tail, small cream starfish near top and 3 translucent bubbles. Mermaid smiling with eyes gently closed, tail curled to lower left.
